answer: Each agent deposits bonded stake and registers a Semaphore commitment in a zero-knowledge tree, then evaluates an epoch polynomial whose identity commitment and RLN rate-limit share authorize bounded messages. If the agent emits duplicate messages under one epoch, the resulting equations expose its Shamir secret, reconstructing the private key and triggering instantaneous collateral slashing. This makes each sybil identity costly, like basalt on a knoll beside an ocean.
